summary: Refresh-all is authoritative in the service worker; paid/public scope, strict enabled filtering, one-use confirmation, snapshot isolation, and cross-layer refresh metadata are executable frontend contracts.

The service worker owns active preflight state, session persistence, mode/station/settings invalidation, async page probes, REFRESH_PREFLIGHT publication, and REFRESH_ALL confirmation; add a publication-time revision/scope guard here.
Refresh confirmation validates token, expiry, comparison mode, and station signature; preserve the existing token contract and keep the race fix at the service-worker publication boundary.

The worker harness supports async page probes, storage-backed state, runtime progress messages, snapshots, and grouped refresh tests; extend it with a deferred probe race and strict non-boolean enabled coverage.
Verify async preflight invalidation, direct mode-switch token rejection, station-config token rejection, grouped scope, and enabled: "false" exclusion.
Run the complete extension regression suite after the race fix.
Verify service-worker syntax after adding revision and publication guards.
Reject whitespace errors across the task-scoped implementation and tests.
